notes: QA hotfix truoc release D2B (Release Audit Phan A.5) - trang thai quickMultiPersonSubmitState 'uncertain'/'done' truoc day CHI khoa bang CSS .phfck-qmp-list.is-locked{pointer-events:none}, KHONG chan duoc: (1) mot field dang giu focus ban phim tu truoc khi khoa duoc bat (dung tinh huong hay gap nhat - dang go thi mat mang), (2) Tab-navigation vao field trong vung khoa, (3) nut Xoa dong (canRemove chi kiem so dong >1, khong kiem trang thai khoa). He qua: noi dung sua sau khi 'uncertain' co the bi gui di duoi request_id CU khi bam 'Thu lai' va bi backend am tham bo qua (upsert onConflict request_id) neu lan goi truoc server thuc ra da luu - sai du lieu am tham, dung dung tieu chi 'phai DUNG release' cua Phan A.5. Fix: them ham quickMultiPersonLocked() (true khi state==='uncertain'||state==='done'), goi dau 3 handler input/change cua field date/note/employee/criterion (return som, khong ghi de row.*) va dua vao dieu kien canRemove cua nut Xoa dong. KHONG doi request_id lifecycle, KHONG doi payload/validation/evidence/backend, KHONG doi hanh vi khi state la 'idle'/'inflight'.
